sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

You'll control a car as it speeds through the streets, dodging obstacles and taking down enemy cars with a barrage of bullets. The game's controls are simple and intuitive, allowing you to jump right in and start playing. You can choose from a variety of cars, each with its unique abilities and strengths. The further you progress, the more cars you can unlock and upgrade, each with its own set of upgrades and abilities.

The game's combat system is also worth noting. You'll have access to a variety of weapons, including machine guns, missiles, and even a homing laser. Each weapon has its own strengths and weaknesses, and you'll need to use them strategically to take down your enemies. You'll also have access to a range of power-ups, including shields, speed boosts, and even a temporary invincibility.
